name: World Region: Legendary Realm
purpose: World Map Region 6 Banner — Legendary Realm.
description: Floating celestial landmasses where gold flows like rivers beneath an eternal crimson eclipse.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector panoramic game environment banner. Mystical floating celestial island silhouettes suspended in the cosmos, floating torii gates and pagoda shrines in the void, beneath a colossal eternal crimson solar eclipse ring. Duotone pitch-black (#000000) and bright crimson-red (#FF2035). Crisp vector edges, no 3D rendering, no realism, no human face, no text, no watermark.
